description.en:
H1-2 is the updated version of Unitree's full-size H1 humanoid platform. Its configuration expands articulation, including six degrees of freedom in each leg and seven in each arm, supporting more flexible movement and manipulation development.

The manufacturer positions the revision around improvements in agility, load handling and endurance, with depth and lidar sensing supporting environmental perception. It remains a development platform whose applications depend on the attached hands, computing configuration and control software. H1-2 specifications should be assessed separately from the original H1, including the conditions attached to payload, speed and runtime figures.

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: H1-2; approximately 7 kg rated per arm; excludes 21 kg peak.

specs.label: Total degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: H1-2; optional hand configuration may differ.
